title: Node.js version for a new API

messages.content: Which Node.js version should we use for a new backend API, and when does it reach end of life?

Use Node.js 24, the current Active LTS line. It stays in Active LTS until October 2026 and then receives maintenance updates until April 2028. Avoid odd-numbered releases (such as Node 25) for production; they are never promoted to LTS.
